page_title: LIV 2-1 BHA | Liverpool v Brighton 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) commits a rough foul. Tony Harrington stops the game and makes a call. Liverpool are awarded a free kick.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Conor Bradley (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Mohamed Salah.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared.
88' Here is a change. Jack Hinshelwood is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Evan Ferguson (Brighton).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jakub Moder (Brighton) replaces Ferdi Kadioglu.
87' A substitution has been made. Kaoru Mitoma goes off and Simon Adingra (Brighton) comes on.
87' Liverpool win a free kick. Tony Harrington interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pervis Estupinan (Brighton).
86' The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
85' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
83' Yellow card. Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
83' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
81' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
81' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Curtis Jones (Liverpool). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
80' It's a throw-in for Brighton.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Darwin Nunez leaves the pitch and Wataru Endo (Liverpool) comes on.
76' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Mats Wieffer (Brighton) replaces Yasin Ayari.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Brajan Gruda (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Joel Veltman.
76' Brighton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
73' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' 2 - 1 GOAL! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) runs onto a pass from Curtis Jones after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from mid range. It’s now 2:1.
70' 1 - 1 Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot into the bottom right corner. What a remarkable goal!
68' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
67' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Dominik Szoboszlai and he is replaced by Luis Diaz (Liverpool).
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is replacing Alexis Mac Allister.

66' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
62' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) makes a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
56' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
53' Liverpool can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Liverpool enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.

48' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is aimed towards the middle of the net, but Bart Verbruggen pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Arne Slot probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ibrahima Konate. He is replaced by Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Tony Harrington has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
45+1' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Caoimhin Kelleher.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Brighton are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
45' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
43' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
42' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.

41' Close! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
40' Tony Harrington blows for a foul after Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brighton.
37' The ball has crossed the sideline. Liverpool are taking a throw-in.

36' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
35' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
32' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Liverpool.

30' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool). He steered the ball towards the middle of the target, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
30' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) steps up to send the ball in.
30' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Liverpool force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

29' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

27' A sweet pass finds Georginio Rutter (Brighton) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Caoimhin Kelleher is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
26' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
24' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) works the corner short.
24' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Yasin Ayari (Brighton), but one of the defenders gets it clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
23' A cross from a corner kick by Brighton is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

22' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort towards the top right corner is saved by the excellent Caoimhin Kelleher. Brighton win a corner.
22' Rough tackle by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton will take a free kick.
21' Tony Harrington interrupts the game. One of the players from Liverpool won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. Brighton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
20' Liverpool take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
20' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool will take a free kick near the side line.
19' The ball is behind the touchline and Liverpool will take a throw-in.
19' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
19' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
18' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

14' 0 - 1 Danny Welbeck produces a killer pass to release Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton), who then unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 0:1!
13' Liverpool are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
11' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
11' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.
10' Liverpool failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.

9' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Bart Verbruggen has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
8' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
4' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for an infringement. Liverpool earn a free kick.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brighton.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
Tony Harrington is introduced as the referee for today's match.
